item.title: Wasurenagusa
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Project-μ
  • 発売日: 2000-11-17
  • スコア: 6.36/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 忘れな草
  • 英語名: Wasurenagusa

あらすじ

After graduating from college, our hero finds himself unable to secure full-time employment and scrapes by with part-time work. One day, Sora receives an unexpected invitation from his high school alumni association.

He was born and raised in a small mountain village, a place whose population has been steadily dwindling. His former school has already closed, and the village itself has been absorbed into a neighboring town. According to the letter, the area is slated to be completely cleared and rebuilt. The old school, too, will soon be demolished.

item.title: Kitamakura Hakase no Yuuutsu
item.description:

  • 発売日: 2000-05-26
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 北麻鞍博士の憂鬱
  • 英語名: Kitamakura Hakase no Yuuutsu

あらすじ

At the end of the 20th century humanity is facing an unprecedented crisis, however most of people are unaware of it. Main character Dr. Kurashira has a genius mind, but he is treated as mad scientist, because he knows the truth of the world… He tracks down school girls who possesses excellent genes in order to pass them to the future generation. But will girls cooperate?
